title: Internal Vent & Pressure Valve Repair
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO MN.USPFO MN PROCUREMENT.W7NG USPFO ACTIVITY MNANG 148
detail_text: The 148th Mission Support Contracting (MSC) Office, intends to issue a sole source contract utilizing FAR part 12.201-1 Simplified Acquisition Procedures to Aero Engineering Support Group (AESG) to perform diagnostics and overhaul or repair the Internal Vent and Pressure Valves for the F-16. The Vendor has an approved Source Approval Request (SAR) by the F-16 System Program Office (SPO). The initial period of performance for this requirement is estimated to be a No Later Delivery Date of July 31, 2026. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quote. All information received by requested date with sufficient technical documentation to meet the requirement will be considered by the 148th MSC. A determination not to compete this proposed contract action based upon response to this notice is solely within the discretion of 148 MSC.
